argv: Rainy blue-hour harbor repair booth; a fictional adult woman unwraps a mended cup for its waiting adult owner.

An environmental portrait captures a layered photographic moment inside a roofed harbor repair booth at rainy blue hour. A fictional adult woman reveals an object to its waiting owner. Use the attached portrait as guidance for her visible face and hair: a dark chin-length bob, wispy fringe, rounded cheeks, brown eyes and softly shaped lips. She stands beside a waist-high wooden workbench in a cream cotton shirt with open collar and rolled sleeves, and dark work trousers. Her right palm supports the underside of an upright pale glazed cup, with fingers curved around its base; her bent right elbow holds it just above the bench. Her left fingertips peel loose brown wrapping paper away from the cup, exposing a thin mended seam. She turns a faint half-smile toward an adult customer in profile at the open doorway, whose hands rest on the far end of the workbench. Radio and coiled wire occupy a shelf; wet pier boards and boats recede outside. Frame her from mid-thigh upward at chest height in a three-quarter view, including her face, both forearms, the cup and the customer's profile. Rain falls beyond the doorway; the dry interior has a smooth blue-painted jamb and a plain matte cream wall. A bare task bulb hangs before a nearly black roof beam, its whole luminous outline surrounded by darkness; warm light touches her cheek and cup. Fine irregular film grain is plainly visible in the flat blue doorway shadows and cream wall midtones. Here, fine irregular image-plane grain is visible in midtones as densely resolved tiny brightness flecks. Subject material details remain distinct from the grain: hair strands, cotton fibers and the cup seam stay legible. A narrow red-orange edge halo follows the brightest task-bulb outline against the dark roof beam. Door-jamb and radio edges retain their neutral dark contours. Highlights on her cheek, the cup glaze and crumpled paper roll gently into pale tones, retaining smooth gradients and material texture. Smooth bright gradation follows each material's form inside crisp surface boundaries.
